page.overview:
What is Skirmish aboard the Casus Belli?

Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, a skirmish was fought aboard the Tagge Corporation research facility ship, the Casus Belli, between employees of the corporation and the ship's droid crew which had been infected by the Scourge. Ultimately, Lady Domina Tagge—the company's leader—deemed the Casus Belli to be beyond saving and had it crashed onto the nearby moon Asheris, resulting in the destruction of the ship and all of the Scourged droids aboard.
